question: Which of the following freedom fighters was a co-founder of Swaraj Party along with Motilal Nehru?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chittaranjan Das**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chittaranjan Das** was a prominent Indian freedom fighter and political leader.
 
• He co-founded the **Swaraj Party** in 1923 along with **Motilal Nehru**.
 
• The Swaraj Party was established to express the discontent of a section of Indian National Congress members with the policies of the British government.
 
• The party aimed to attain self-governance and was active in the legislative councils.
 
• Chittaranjan Das was also known as **Deshbandhu**, meaning "Friend of the Nation".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chittaranjan Das** was also a renowned lawyer and defended many freedom fighters in court.
 
• He played a significant role in the **Non-Cooperation Movement** led by Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• His leadership and vision greatly contributed to the Indian independence struggle.
 
• Chittaranjan Das passed away in 1925, but his legacy continues to inspire generations.
 
• The **Swaraj Party** eventually merged back into the Indian National Congress.
